# Raspberry Pi 4 Configuration
arm_64bit=1
kernel=Image
enable_uart=1
dtoverlay=disable-bt

# I2C — required for DS3231 RTC, SHT3x, and BH1750 on GPIO2/GPIO3 (I2C1)
dtparam=i2c_arm=on

# Custom device tree overlays

# gpio
dtoverlay=gpio-leds
dtoverlay=gpio-rust
dtoverlay=gpio-chardev
dtoverlay=gpio-inputs

# i2c
dtoverlay=ds3231-rtc
dtoverlay=sht3x
dtoverlay=bh1750

arm_boost=1
